newsitem.title: USA: Policeman's son shows grim photos at school.
newsitem.headline: Policeman's son shows grim photos at school.

text.p: Eric Prichard's schoolmates were in for a shock when he showed them photographs from his dad's work.

The photos showed the post-autopsy body of a youth who had died of a drug overdose, the St. Petersburg Times reported on Thursday. Prichard's father Charlie, a police detective sergeant, had taken the photos home from his office. Eric, 17, took them from his briefcase and passed them around at school.
"I really sympathise with the parents of the kid in the pictures. I'm always going to remember the hurt I may have caused them," Charlie Prichard told the Times.
Pinellas Park High Principal Denise Hart said: "These photos are disturbing to young people. It is not something we would encourage."
Eric was suspended from school and his father was reprimanded by police chiefs.
